description: This Java class 'TenantDatabaseUpgradeService' manages database schema upgrades for tenants in the Fineract platform. It performs initial and incremental schema migrations using Liquibase, handles multiple tenants concurrently, and logs detailed tenant information.

classes.name: TenantDatabaseUpgradeService
classes.description: Service for upgrading tenant databases and the tenant store schema during application startup, using Liquibase migrations.

methods.name: afterPropertiesSet
methods.description: Initializes database upgrades after bean properties are set, managing tenant store and individual tenant schemas.

methods.name: notLiquibaseOnlyMode
methods.description: Checks if the application is running in a mode that includes schema upgrades.

methods.name: upgradeTenantStore
methods.description: Performs schema upgrade for the tenant store database.

methods.name: logTenantStoreDetails
methods.description: Logs detailed information about the tenant store configuration.

methods.name: upgradeIndividualTenants
methods.description: Upgrades schemas for all tenants concurrently.

methods.name: createTenantUpgradeThreadPoolTaskExecutor
methods.description: Creates a thread pool executor for parallel tenant upgrades.

methods.name: upgradeIndividualTenant
methods.description: Upgrades a single tenant's database schema.

methods.name: applyInitialLiquibase
methods.description: Applies initial Liquibase migration or syncs changelog if needed.
